plugins.label: Adoption
plugins.description: Skills for Power Platform adoption storytelling — turn customer stories into polished, brand-matched HTML presentation decks.

plugins.label: Canvas Apps
plugins.description: Skills to analyze Canvas App performance and quality.

plugins.label: Code Apps
plugins.description: Skills to generate brand-aligned design guides for code apps built on the Power Platform.

plugins.label: Dataverse
plugins.description: Skills for authoring and troubleshooting Microsoft Dataverse Web API queries — natural language to OData, FetchXML conversion, multi-surface targeting, and error diagnosis.

plugins.label: Governance
plugins.description: Skills for Power Platform governance and administration — provision developer environments with standard governance defaults and automate admin center workflows.

plugins.label: Pro-Code Eval
plugins.description: Automated eval generation for Power Apps Code Apps and Generative Pages — feature presence checks, unit tests, static security analysis, and an HTML dashboard.

plugins.label: Admin Digest
plugins.description: Power Platform admin digest — Message Center notices, Service Health incidents, Known Issues, and deprecations that can affect production operations, with shareability tiering so customer-facing summaries never leak NDA content.

plugins.label: OverFlow
plugins.description: Reviews every Power Automate cloud flow inside a Power Platform solution (.zip) against Microsoft's coding guidelines, produces a [SolutionName].findings.json next to the uploaded solution, then opens the hosted PowerCAT-Overflow viewer at https://microsoft.github.io/power-cat-skills/PowerCAT-Overflow.html and uploads both files so the user can explore the results.

plugins.label: OverPage
plugins.description: Reviews the Power Pages site(s) inside a Power Platform solution (.zip) against best practices across Security, Performance, Accessibility, Maintainability, Architecture and Reliability, optionally using a browser HAR capture to investigate real performance bottlenecks. Produces a [SolutionName].findings.json with solution, per-site and per-component findings (descriptions, fixes, code/HAR anchors), then opens the hosted PowerCAT OverPage viewer at https://microsoft.github.io/power-cat-skills/PowerCAT-OverPage.html so the user can explore findings overlaid on a live page preview, on the actual code, and on the network waterfall.
